notes: Settings, empty states, title bar and tabs on the donor idiom: settingsBits gains the kit Input, a concentric Segmented and a disabled-aware Select that ThreadDefaultsDialog, OrchestrationRules, buildSettings and SettingsView adopt in place of hand-rolled inputs, with MatrixSpinner loaders, DANGER buttons, one-clause copy, 11px uppercase section labels and text-2xl page titles; TitleBar tabs are h-7 px-2 with size-6 pressable close and chevron buttons, 11px tabular counts and px-2 clusters; SurfaceTabs drops its /2 wash, fades the dragged tab in 100 ms and marks insertions with a rounded-full inset-y-1.5 bar (Sidebar too); the sidebar opens with a 120 ms opacity fade instead of a width tween; WorkspaceSessions loses its layoutId pill, MotionConfig and list glide for transition-colors washes (/10 selected, /5 hover, /10 active, warning/8 paused), size-6 pressable kebabs, strokeWidth 1.75 glyphs and an uppercase Archived header with a 150 ms chevron; TerminalSpinner is one glyph wide, tinted by className and frozen under reduced motion; MenuBar buttons and MarkdownModeToggle take the rounded-md/[4px] concentric recipe without glass; ProjectDialogs' mode control is a radiogroup; InboxView, NotesView and SearchView swap LoaderCircle for MatrixSpinner, show errors in text-danger, use the underline tab recipe, text-2xl titles, tabular Updated stamps and h-7 pressable primary buttons, and drop the "Pull request"/"Issue" and project-name echoes, the "Note" crumb and the dot-grid empty tile for the bare-icon empty state; ReleaseNotesSurface sits at px-8 py-8 with the same empty state; the terminal pane pads 12px; SettingsRail's Workspaces label takes the section recipe; the unused SessionsEmpty component is gone
